paths.date-fns: The index loads every function. Import from date-fns/<function>.
paths.date-fns/locale: The index loads every locale. Import from date-fns/locale/<code>.
paths.date-fns/startOfWeek: Week boundaries and week numbering depend on the user's week-start setting; these default to Sunday (or, for getISOWeek, hardcode Monday). Use startOfAppWeek / endOfAppWeek / isSameAppWeek / getAppWeek from ~/utils/time-utils, or add a wrapper there.
